page.overview:
Who is Sashalle Anderly?

She has blue eyes and curly hair, wore in ringlets to her shoulders, also a stubborn jaw. After being stilled and Healed, she has lost the ageless look and, instead, looked merely short of her middle years. She also looked prettier after losing her ageless look.

Sashalle is very strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength of . Only four other women out the Tower loyalists we have details on can match her strength, and only Elaida exceeds it.}} After being Healed, she was restored to her full strength, although she was no longer bound by the Three Oaths.

Her name indicates that she is likely from Andor. She was born in and went to the White Tower in . She was a novice for nine years and Accepted for six. Sashalle was raised to the shawl in .

Sashalle was one of the Aes Sedai involved in Rand al'Thor's kidnapping. Along with Galina, she was the strongest in this expedition, and so they were at the top in the hierarchy when the Red Ajah took charge after diplomatic failure.
